very impressive at all, on multiple occasions.
1. Was suffering with heart failure (genuinely, and ended up getting admitted to hospital within a week at my insistence). Visit to the doctor and he didn’t even bother to take my blood pressure and after listening to my lungs which had filled up with liquid by this stage, he said it was a chest infection and sent me on my way.  For reference the hospital recorded my blood pressure as being 238/120 which is at life threatening levels and my ejection fraction at 20!
2. Same doctor today, visited to have them look at a condition I was experiencing, and after asking me the same questions a number of times, said that I’d have to go to a different service. No thoughts offered on what the condition was, just said it wasn’t his job to comment.
3. Blood test results - reception called me the day after and said that a doctor (same one as above) had checked my results and said that there was an issue that needed addressing urgently. I called up my hospital contacts from point 1 above as had a feeling that this particular doctor was wrong yet again. The hospital team checked my results and said that they were absolutely fine and nothing to worry about. Another doctor called me from the surgery and told me to ignore what the first doctor had apparently said about my results.

Not happy and am now going to steer well clear of the one particular doctor!",null,[0,207]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/16103677691315494597/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOY1RBelVEWkNNazQyZVhSQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/16103677691315494597/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOY1RBelVEWkNNazQyZVhSQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/16103677691315494597/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOY1RBelVEWkNNazQyZVhSQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/16103677691315494597/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOY1RBelVEWkNNazQyZVhSQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/16103677691315494597/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOY1RBelVEWkNNazQyZVhSQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/16103677691315494597/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOY1RBelVEWkNNazQyZVhSQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VNcTAzUDZCMk42eXRBRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xc8e2c62373870609!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEMq03P6B2N6ytAE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VNcTAzUDZCMk42eXRBRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VNcTAzUDZCMk42eXRBRRIsChZDSUhNMG9nS0VMZS0wdFhtalBhQkZBEhJDZ3NJck9fbndBWVFpSkhSSHcaLQoXQ0lITTBvZ0tFTHo0a3NxLW1xRHVqUUUSEkNnc0lyT19ud0FZUWlKSFJIdyISCQAAAAAAAAAAEQkGh3MjxuLIKhJDZ3NJck9fbndBWVFpSkhSSHc&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiY56uLwbGTAxWpIGMBHRohGCUQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiY56uLwbGTAxWpIGMBHRohGCUQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMnhoYTBsbVpGOWZSV2hFUm0xZmNXSlZVbUZQZVVwYWNXNXVaMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpqU1VOaFZuRlJhRGt3V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNneWJYdlFBEAE",["0x0:0xc8e2c62373870609",null,1739890255487668,1739890255487668,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103348393015525234064/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Rob
